$comment: DEVWORLD execution worker runtime registry. Each runtime runs untrusted player code in a fresh Docker container. Placeholders in build/run commands: {entry} = entry file path relative to /work, {entryBase} = entry file name without extension, {stdinFile} = /work/__stdin.txt (always materialized, may be empty). imageBuild points at a Dockerfile directory in this repo for toolchains with no trustworthy prebuilt image; build those with `bun run pull-runtimes`.

runtimes.label: Python
runtimes.notes: Reference interpreter; pip installs are not available (no network).

runtimes.label: JavaScript (Node.js)
runtimes.notes: Node.js LTS runtime; npm installs are not available (no network).

runtimes.label: TypeScript
runtimes.notes: Custom image: node:22-slim plus typescript@5.9 (tsc must be baked in because containers have no network). Compiles the entry file, then runs the emitted JS.

runtimes.label: C (GCC)
runtimes.notes: Compiles every .c file at the project root into one binary.

runtimes.label: C++ (G++)
runtimes.notes: Compiles every .cpp file at the project root into one binary.

runtimes.label: Java
runtimes.notes: Compiles every .java file at the project root. The entry file's public class name must match its file name (e.g. Main.java defines class Main).

runtimes.label: C# (.NET)
runtimes.notes: Custom image: .NET 9 SDK with a csc-shim wrapper around the bundled Roslyn compiler (dotnet run project scaffolding needs network for restore, so direct Roslyn compile is used instead). Compiles every .cs file at the project root.

runtimes.label: Go
runtimes.notes: Builds every .go file at the project root (single package, file mode, no go.mod needed). GOCACHE is redirected to /work because the root filesystem is read-only.

runtimes.label: Rust
runtimes.notes: Single-file compile with rustc (no Cargo; multi-file crates are not supported).

runtimes.label: SQL (SQLite)
runtimes.notes: Custom image: alpine plus the sqlite3 CLI. The script runs against an empty in-memory database; per-test stdin is appended to the script as extra SQL.

runtimes.label: Swift
runtimes.notes: Official Swift image. Compiles every .swift file at the project root. First compile is slow; the default timeout accounts for it.

runtimes.label: Kotlin
runtimes.notes: Custom image: Temurin 21 JDK plus the Kotlin 2.2 compiler from JetBrains releases (no trustworthy official Kotlin Docker image exists). Compiles every .kt file at the project root into a jar; the entry file should define fun main().

runtimes.label: Dart
runtimes.notes: Official Dart SDK image, runs JIT (no ahead-of-time compile step).

runtimes.label: Julia
runtimes.notes: Official Julia image. JIT startup and precompilation are slow; the default timeout accounts for it.

runtimes.label: Scala
runtimes.notes: Custom image: Temurin 21 JDK plus Scala 3.7 via Coursier (no trustworthy official Scala image exists). Compiles every .scala file at the project root. The entry file should define an @main object named after the file (e.g. Main.scala defines the Main entry point).

runtimes.label: Haskell (GHC)
runtimes.notes: Official Haskell image. Compiles the entry file with --make (imported local modules are followed). GHC is slow and memory-hungry; limits account for it.

runtimes.label: Zig
runtimes.notes: Custom image: Debian slim plus the Zig 0.15.1 toolchain from ziglang.org (no official Zig Docker image exists). Single-file build-exe.

runtimes.label: x86-64 Assembly (NASM)
runtimes.notes: Custom image: alpine plus nasm and binutils. Assembles with nasm -f elf64 and links with ld (no libc). Programs must use raw Linux syscalls and a _start entry point.
